successors.name: Zhaobaogou culture
successors.text: Aohan Banner, Chifeng, Inner Mongolia: the type site of the Xinglongwa and the Zhaobaogou

ledger.x: 6000 BCE: the Xinglongwa millet villages hold the Liao River basin on the Inner Mongolia-Liaoning border (the culture "6200-5400 BC" began before the project's first year).
5400 BCE: the Chaoyang side of the Liao basin is left empty: the Zhaobaogou page places its culture only in the Luan valley and at Aohan, and the Hongshan does not begin until 4700.
5400 BCE: the Xinglongwa culture ends ("Xinglongwa culture (6200-5400 BC)") and the Zhaobaogou follows at Aohan, Chifeng ("Followed by: Zhaobaogou culture").

certainty.note: No border is recorded; known from a few sites.
